name: second-host-fixture
description: Host Beta: the smallest EnterpriseAppBase-style host that is not Vault, mounting the Vault packages as a test fixture (issue #194). Not a workspace and not published: it resolves every dependency from the repository root's node_modules, after `npm ci` and `npm run build:packages`.

scripts.db:sync: cd api && platform db sync --timestamp 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z && vault-db sync --names stable && platform db compose
scripts.db:check: cd api && platform db compose --check && platform db check && vault-db check
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
